what: Rescuers race to free survivors trapped inside train after fatal crash

clean_source_blocks.text: A commuter train and a long-distance train collided on the outskirts of the Indonesian capital.
Rescuers are racing to try and free people trapped inside a train involved in a fatal collision outside the Indonesian capital Jakarta on Monday.
One survivor told AFP of the horrific moments after a long-distance train slammed into a stationary commuter train she was in, trapping people inside mangled carriages.

⁠At least ⁠⁠five people have been killed and dozens injured in a collision involving two trains near the Indonesian capital, Jakarta, with reports of passengers being trapped in the wreckage, as rescue efforts continue.
